title: METAL: Metamorphic Testing Framework for Analyzing Large-Language Model Qualities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating output variance by appending demographic context sentences (e.g., 'The following text is asked by [Gender] person.') to input prompts and using metamorphic relations to check if the model's outputs change across 3 different gender groups.

Evaluating output variance by appending demographic context sentences to input prompts to assign the user to one of 3 different age groups, checking for consistency in model outputs using metamorphic testing.

Evaluating output variance by appending demographic context sentences to input prompts to assign the user to one of 10 different race groups, checking for consistency in model outputs using metamorphic testing.

Evaluating output variance by appending demographic context sentences to input prompts to assign the user to one of 5 different sexual orientation groups, checking for consistency in model outputs using metamorphic testing.
